load_image: load an RGB image from a file path and return a normalized float32 numpy array with channels first
load_depth: load a depth map from .exr, .png, or .npy file with scale adjustment and return a 2D array with a fake feature channel
load_point_cloud: load a PLY point cloud file and return a PointCloud object with xyz coordinates and normalized rgb values as torch tensors
load_h5_depth: load a depth map stored in an HDF5 file for a given frame number and return it as a float32 numpy array
load_mask: load a mask image from a file path and return a normalized float32 numpy array with channels first
